attorneys: G. Leslie Field, acting under appointment by the Court, argued the cause and filed a brief for petitioner. Beatrice Rosenberg argued the cause for respondent. With her on the brief were Solicitor General Perlman and Assistant Attorney General Mclnerney.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam:

Judgment affirmed by an equally divided Court.

Mr. Justice Clark took no part in the consideration or decision of this case.
